Any of a class of chemical compounds that act on cannabinoid receptors in cells.

items.word: The city was devastated by a massive conflagration that lasted for days.
items.definition:
conflagration
An extensive fire that destroys a great deal of land or property.

items.word: The novel perfectly captured the zeitgeist of the 1960s.
items.definition:
geist
spirit or ghost; the intellectual, moral, and cultural climate of an era

items.word: Glycoproteins play a crucial role in cell recognition.
items.definition:
glycoprotein
any of a class of proteins that have carbohydrate groups attached to the polypeptide chain

items.word: The politician's speech was full of obfuscation, avoiding direct answers.
items.definition:
obfuscation
the action of making something obscure, unclear, or unintelligible

items.word: The process of sanctification is central to many religious beliefs and practices.
items.definition:
sanctification
the action of making or declaring something holy; the process of becoming holy

items.word: Vanadium is used to make strong steel alloys.
items.definition:
vanadium
a hard, silvery-grey metallic element

items.word: Genes are composed of introns and exons.
items.definition:
exon
a segment of a DNA or RNA molecule containing information coding for a protein or peptide sequence
